inicio.subtitulo: Accessibility and communication at Capim Dourado Shopping
inicio.escolherLocal: Not here? Choose where you are
inicio.semLocal: Scan a Guia Dourado sign or choose where you are.
inicio.oQueFazer: What would you like to do?

T01.objetivo: Choose what helps you. Your preferences stay on this phone only.

T02.objetivo: Floor plan with layers and a list alternative.

T03.objetivo: Find stores, services and restrooms by name, number, category or voice.

T04.objetivo: Place information in text, voice, plain language and sign language.

T05.objetivo: Step-by-step accessible route, with elevator status.

T06.objetivo: Face-to-face conversation with captions, type-to-speak, translation and ready phrases.

T07.objetivo: Tap a picture to show and speak the sentence.

T08.objetivo: Ask the mall staff for help. In an emergency, call 192, 193 or 190.

T09.objetivo: Follow your request in real time.

T10.objetivo: Tell us about the route or report a barrier.

T11.objetivo: Accessible restrooms, baby changing, reserved tables, quiet area and more.

guia.objetivo: For blind or low-vision people: the camera recognizes where you are and the app tells you how far is left, when you are close and when you have arrived.
guia.paraOnde: Where do you want to go?
guia.aviso: The guide complements the white cane and guide dog; it does not replace them. No image is recorded.
guia.imagemCamera: Camera image used to recognize the place
guia.f_semBase: There is no route base yet. The team must train it with the video.
guia.f_cameraLigada: Camera on. Walk slowly with the phone on your chest.
guia.f_semCamera: Could not open the camera. Use the demo video.
guia.f_trecho: You are in the {nome}. Keep going straight.
guia.f_naoSei: I have not recognized where you are yet. Walk slowly.
guia.f_destino: Destination: {nome}. About {passos} steps. Keep going straight.
guia.f_destinoSemPosicao: Destination: {nome}. First I will find out where you are.
guia.f_faltam: Keep going straight. About {passos} steps to {nome}.
guia.f_chegouPassos: You should have arrived: {nome}. Wait for the camera to confirm.
guia.f_semMovimento: This device does not report motion. Position will use the camera only.
guia.f_movimentoNegado: Motion permission denied. Position will use the camera only.
guia.f_passou: Caution: you walked past {nome}. Turn around and go back about {passos} steps.
guia.f_contramao: Caution: you are walking the wrong way. Turn around. {nome} is about {passos} steps away.
guia.f_virarEmFrente: In {passos} steps, {texto} ahead of you: turn {lado}.

letreiro.objetivo: Point the camera at a storefront and your phone says which store is in front of you.

local.dicaToques: {n, plural, one {✨ # tap to reveal the secret dish} other {✨ # taps to reveal the secret dish}}
local.itemSecretoSimples: Special combo: burger, fries and a drink for thirteen reais. No scares!

busca.dica: Type at least 2 letters. E.g.: “ca” finds C&A and “restroom” finds the toilets.

letreiro.guia: Keep the sign in the center of the screen, about 2 to 5 meters away.
letreiro.ligada: Camera on. Point at the store sign; I will tell you when I recognize it.
letreiro.naoReconheci: No store recognized. Move closer or point at the name on the storefront.
letreiro.aviso: The reader can make mistakes: check your surroundings or ask for help. The image is read on your phone and is never sent to a server.
letreiro.internet: The first time, the reader downloads about 5 MB. After that it works even with a weak connection.

erros.inseguro: The camera only works on a secure address (https).
erros.semSuporte: This browser does not allow camera access.
erros.negada: No permission to use the camera. Allow the camera in your browser settings and try again.
erros.naoEncontrada: No camera was found on this device.
erros.emUso: The camera is being used by another app.
erros.ocr: The sign reader could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
erros.desconhecido: The camera could not be turned on.

letreiro.alternativa: Prefer not to use the camera? Use search.
